answer_1.quote: We introduce SimulatorArena, a benchmark for evaluating user simulators in multi-turn conversations on two tasks: math tutoring and document creation.
answer_1.outputs: User simulation responses in multi-turn conversations

answer_2.quote: SimulatorArena enables automatic evaluation of (1) how closely simulator messages resemble real user messages, using metrics such as LLM-judged Turing tests, and (2) how well simulators align with human evaluations of assistants, measured by the correlation between the assistant ratings from the simulator and human users.

answer_3.quote: To assess message similarity, we use two complementary evaluation methods with GPT-4o as judge: Likert Scale... Turing Test.

answer_4.quote: It contains 909 authentic, annotated human-LLM conversations, collected from 107 participants chatting with 9 LLMs... Human evaluations are the gold standard... We use Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) to collect the human-LLM conversations.
answer_4.guideline: Users rate the assistant's interaction quality on a 1-10 scale... For document creation, they also provide a 1-10 rating for the final document.
